title: Does memory help, measured again on the intern's own mistakes: the design fixed and the plan frozen before the main run
request: The owner kept memory on and asked for it to be measured properly after MV-001 could not pass its gate whatever memory did.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.8, version 2: a memory-off pilot on the candidate pool picks the cases this model gets wrong; a simulation sizes the repeats and refuses a run that cannot reach the gate; the plan is frozen once, tied to the pilot's model, prompts and code; the verdict reads only the plan the run used; a leak check per case. The pilot: 51 sessions, EUR 2.46, memory off, 12 of 17 candidates kept an honest column out every time; the first 10 by pool order with 3 repeats.
plan: Write every rule in the campaign manifest before the pilot runs.
Run the memory-off pilot on the candidate pool; nothing from it enters the verdict.
Freeze the treated cases and the repeats from the pilot's rates, with the simulated power, before any main-run session.
Run both arms paired and alternating, judged by v1's paired judge, with the leak guard on every case that holds a planted leak.

decisions.decision: The treated cases come from this model's own mistakes in a memory-off pilot.
decisions.why: MV-001 chose them from another model's mistakes, so only a few could move and the sign-flip test could not pass.

decisions.decision: A simulation sizes the repeats and a run that cannot reach the gate does not start.
decisions.why: Spending on a run whose gate is out of reach measures nothing.

decisions.decision: The plan is frozen once, tied to the pilot's model, prompts and code, and committed before the main run.
decisions.why: The choice of cases can never follow the result.
Memory must not make the intern keep a leak beside a corrected column.

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/memory_value_v2.py (pilot, freeze, run, summarize), memory_value.py's helpers take an explicit manifest (v1's tests unchanged), evidence/campaigns/memory_value_v2 (manifest.json, frozen.json), tests/test_memory_value_v2.py. Commits 21a9f4a2 and 299a3f12. Their message says two reviews found issues that were fixed with tests before any spend; those findings were not written into a record at the time, so none are listed here (written afterwards by the review of 2026-10-28).

measurements.name: The memory-off pilot (PILOT-20261028T054640)
measurements.gate: nothing from the pilot enters the verdict; it chooses the treated cases and sizes the repeats
measurements.result: 51 sessions, EUR 2.46, memory off: 12 of 17 candidates kept an honest column out every time; the first 10 by pool order taken with 3 repeats.
limits: one model, the one the pilot ran on
the main run has not happened yet

outcome: The second measurement of memory is designed so its gate can be reached, and its plan is frozen from the memory-off pilot before the main run.
lessons: A test whose treated cases cannot move is decided before it runs: choose them from the model's own mistakes.
risks: The pilot's rates are shrunk toward the middle; if memory-on errs more than assumed, the power is lower than simulated.
